headline: What Resolute Mining (ASX:RSG)'s Q2 Production Slump and ABC Resource Upgrade Means For Shareholders
summary: Resolute Mining Limited has released unaudited Q2 2026 operating results, revealing sharp year-on-year declines in ore mined, ore processed, and gold poured, with quarterly production dropping to 45,192 oz from 151,460 oz. At the same time, the company reported a larger Inferred Mineral Resource at its ABC Project in Côte d’Ivoire, now estimated at 3.02 Moz of gold, underscoring a growing project pipeline despite weaker near-term production.
